formSteps.heading: Steps to complete this form
formSteps.description: You can save your progress and come back later if you're signed in.

steps.title: Select your program
steps.description: Identify whether your claim is under the Spina Bifida or CWVV program

steps.title: Patient information (Section I)
steps.description: Enter the beneficiary's name, Social Security number, date of birth, address, and phone number

steps.title: Sponsor information (Section II)
steps.description: Enter the qualifying Veteran parent's name and Social Security number

steps.title: Claim type
steps.description: Select the types of expenses you are claiming

steps.title: Travel information (Section III — if claiming travel)
steps.description: Enter provider certification, travel dates and routes, attendant information, and expense amounts
steps.conditionalNote: This section is required only if you selected travel expenses on the previous step

steps.title: Expenses and receipts
steps.description: Enter expense amounts and upload your receipts

steps.title: Certification and signature (Section IV)
steps.description: Certify that the information you provided is correct and sign the claim

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.description: Review all your information and submit your claim
